photos.title: Atlantic Ocean shoreline in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
photos.what: A row of oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach, from the beach. The top of one beach umbrella shows in the lower left corner. No person is in the frame.
photos.caption: Oceanfront towers in Myrtle Beach.
photos.alt: A row of high-rise towers with balconies along the beach in Myrtle Beach under a clear sky
photos.author: Loadmaster (David R. Tribble)
photos.credit: Photo: Loadmaster (David R. Tribble), CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
photos.provenance: Licence and author confirmed on the file page by the batch 2026-11-e verifier (VERIFY.md, photos table: CC BY-SA 3.0, Loadmaster (David R. Tribble), 30 June 2014, 2592 x 1728). Downloaded as Commons' 1920 px rendition on 2026-11-04. The same source photo as /invest/short-term-rental-rules-statehouse/, cropped differently.
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-04 (fix round 1). The crop (x 240 to 880, y 200 to 520 of the 1920 x 1280 rendition, resized to 1200 x 600) keeps the towers and leaves out the beach and its people; only the top of one umbrella shows in a corner. The towers are not named and the caption does not say whether each is a hotel or condos: every unit an owner rents out, in either, is taxed at 6% (S.C. Const. Art. X, Sec. 1(5)).
